description:
You are acting as a configuration manager responsible for maintaining the release process for a software project. In the project directory located at /home/user/config-app, there is a file named VERSION that contains the current semantic version number, initially set to 1.4.2. There is also a CHANGELOG.md file that documents all notable changes to the project. Your tasks are: 1. Simulate a minor version bump (increase the middle version component by one, reset the patch component to zero), update the VERSION file to reflect the new version, which should be 1.5.0. 2. Add a new entry to the top of /home/user/config-app/CHANGELOG.md describing the configuration changes shipped in this release. The new entry must strictly follow this format, with all the required fields: 
## [1.5.0] - 2024-06-20

### Added
- New option max_retries in config.yml (default: 5)

### Changed
- Updated default log level to INFO in config.yml

### Fixed
- Resolved error with invalid port number in service_manager.py
The heading must have today's date in YYYY-MM-DD format (2024-06-20) as shown above. Ensure there is a single blank line before the new entry, and the previous changelog entries are not modified or removed. 3. Verify your changes by listing (print to console) both the contents of VERSION and CHANGELOG.md. This task will be automatically verified. Ensure the version file and changelog precisely match the specified formats above.
